content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to monitor five [product_name] PLCs ([version_no]) using [product_name] V [version_no]. I have set up the PC station with [product_name] V [version_no] without issues. However, when creating variables with [product_name] V10, I encounter problems. My questions are: 1) How should I set the connection parameters for my [product_name] program in this application? Should I use client or server connection? For TSAP values, there are only two options (02.00 for operator panel, or 20.00), but in [product_name], when setting the S7 connection address details, the local (PC station) and partner ([product_name] PLC [version_no]) TSAP values need to be specified, and the partner device does not offer 02.00 for TSAP. 2) How should I create variables in [product_name] V10 so they can be read and written in [product_name] V [version_no]? Thank you for any help.
Hello [user_name], It might be helpful if you upload your program as a zip file. This would make it easier to pinpoint what might be missing.

Hi, To get TSAP 02.00 in [product_name], you need to enable the "Operator Panel" option. When you add extra communication channels, each one receives a different TSAP, starting from 20.00 up to 27.00. One suggestion: create a second server connection in [product_name] to get TSAP 21.00 and test this with [product_name]. Also, note that [product_name] only has DB1, which should be used in [product_name]. Hope this is useful.

Thank you for your responses! [user_name], how can I configure variables in [product_name] so they can be viewed and accessed in DB1 through [product_name]? Currently, I can only configure and access M and Q variables, but I can't seem to create variables in the database. If [product_name] has DB1, how do I set it up in [product_name]?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges configuring communication between [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] V[version_no] using [product_name] V[version_no], especially regarding TSAP parameter settings and variable mapping. The lack of clear documentation and user-friendly setup for establishing OPC connectivity leads to uncertainty about appropriate TSAP values and how to properly configure variables, such as those related to DB1, for monitoring in [product_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy-to-follow process for configuring communication parameters between [product_name] devices and [product_name] for successful integration, plus detailed instructions for variable creation and mapping, particularly for accessing DB1.
